items.title: Elf Pulling a Christmas Toy Train
items.alt: Braided cartoon elf in a green tunic pulling a red-and-green toy locomotive with two gift-filled wagons.
items.description: A cord connects the elf's hand to the small locomotive. Presents, candy canes and a teddy bear ride in the two wagons behind the skipping figure.

items.title: Elf Holding a Toy Sailboat
items.alt: Blue-eyed cartoon elf in a green jacket holding a wooden sailboat and touching the top of its cream sail.
items.description: One hand supports the boat's red-brown hull while the other reaches toward the mast. A floppy green cap, red shorts and long striped stockings distinguish the standing elf.

items.title: Elf Putting Away a Storybook
items.alt: Blond cartoon elf standing on a small wooden step and sliding a green book onto a two-shelf bookcase.
items.description: The elf looks back while placing a plain green volume on the little bookcase. Heart-shaped cutouts, rows of festive book spines and a low two-step stool make the reading corner distinct.

items.title: Two Elves Tying a Giant Gift Bow
items.alt: Two different green-clothed cartoon elves holding opposite loops of a large red bow above a cream Christmas gift.
items.description: A white-haired elf in a green coat works beside a dark-braided elf in a green dress. Their different caps, stockings and faces frame the oversized red bow between them.

items.title: Elf in a Wheelchair with Christmas Gifts
items.alt: Auburn-braided cartoon elf seated in a manual wheelchair with a lap parcel and a small gift wagon alongside.
items.description: The green-clothed elf holds a cream gift with a red bow above the wheelchair footplate. A red wagon beside the chair carries a teddy bear, candy canes and more wrapped parcels.

items.title: Elf Sleeping in a Leaf Hammock
items.alt: Small curly-haired cartoon elf asleep in a green leaf hammock suspended between two carved wooden posts.
items.description: Folded hands, closed eyes and bent striped legs give the elf a peaceful pose. Holly-tied ropes support the leaf-shaped hammock between two complete scroll-topped stands.
